en: WASD / arrows / left stick to move. Walk into fish to catch; stand on pads to drop / take / stock / serve / trash. Cash on the money pad goes into your wallet; stand on a price pad for a moment to pay. Autosave every 10 s; F9 = new game.
zh_TW: WASD / 方向鍵 / 手把左搖桿移動。走進水裡碰到魚就抓;站在格子上自動放貨、拿貨、上架、收銀、丟棄。錢格的錢會收進錢包;在價格牌上站一下就開始付錢。每 10 秒自動存檔;F9 重新開始。
